description: Revoke one of your tokens by type and id. It stops working on its next use; this cannot be undone. `type` is pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_). PATs need 'admin' scope; repository and deploy tokens need 'repo'. Audit-logged.

type.description: Token type: pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_)

name: gluecron_revoke_token
